text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(What was I doing again...? Wait, where 
even am I?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft, ...—Craft!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Unya... Huh. It's Cesario~..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Don't "mya" me, Craft. Were you 
asleep this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Looks like it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... That's right, Cesario invited me to 
go shopping this morning, but...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(The weather was so nice, it made me want 
to bask in the sun by the window, and so—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's already past noon!? No 
wonder... I'm so hungry~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Did you fall asleep and forget to eat? 
Craft—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you completely exhausted? Is the 
training for the Victoria Mile really that 
brutal?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh! No, I'm not tired at all! I'm totally 
fine, super duper energetic!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'm burning with passion! 
Because—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"You watched it with me too, right, 
Cesario? That graded race the other day!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A clash between the "Empress" Air Groove 
and the "Amazon" Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That was amazing. The venue was 
overflowing with a huge crowd, just like 
on a GⅠ race day.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right! It was so exciting!! Everyone was 
paying huge attention to the Tiara 
Umamusume...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and Ikuno Dictus have 
announced their entry for the next Yasuda 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Both that race and this race are packed 
with dream clashes between Tiara 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why, for the Victoria 
Mile! Heart-san, Messiah-san, and I... we 
new-generation Tiara Umamusume want to 
fire everyone up!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in an extraordinary race. 
I'm so fired up, seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Aah~, talking about it is making me 
want to run all of a sudden! All riiiight—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Four.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I can feel your enthusiasm, don't 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Gotta eat first if we wanna do our best. 
Let's eat together, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... okaay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... alongside a fired-up Rhein Kraft, 
the day of the Victoria Mile had finally 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Heaaaaart~~~~!! Messiah, you're the one 
who's gonna beat Craft!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Messiaaaah! I'll be waiting at the finish 
line! Use that razor-sharp late kick to 
blow right past them all!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Such tremendous passion... ...The number 
of banners looks like more than double the 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That just shows how much attention it's 
getting♪ Unusually for this race, it's 
made up almost entirely of girls from the 
same generation."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Before taking on the Legend, doesn't 
everyone think we should decide who stands 
at the center of our generation?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Then I'll take first place!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh. There you are, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll become the number one Tiara 
Umamusume... and conquer that dream race!
